_why: The claim ledger matches a claim against a sliding window of the harness. A rule that moved AND was reworded can fail that match while being perfectly present — and a claim that was deliberately deleted because it was FALSE should not be reported as a loss at all. Both need an answer that a reviewer can check in seconds, not a promise that somebody was careful. Every entry below is verified mechanically by claim-ledger.mjs: a `relocated` entry fails unless `contains` is really present in `to`, and a `corrected` entry fails unless `evidence` really exists. Padding this file with a bogus row breaks the build.
